title: Fix reading ase gui configuration file
body: Added 'gui_default_settings' to the global dictionary when reading ~/.ase/gui.py to prevent ase gui from crashing if a config file exists.
author: friisj

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Okay, this makes sense.  Will merge since it solves an immediate problem.

However I think we should to .ini-style configfiles in the future and also move the configuration into `~/.config/ase` which seems to be a more modern standard.  If someone wants to execute other code, then can just write their own executable which wraps the GUI.  Should we create an issue for this change?
